title: pull_request_target blocked by default December 2
summary: Starting December 2, 2026, GitHub Actions will block pull_request_target events by default in all public repositories, unless an applicable Actions event policy explicitly allows them.[^c-30f2ff899c] Enforcement was previously scheduled for November 2, 2026.[^c-9534c210d0] GitHub introduced this default rule through workflow execution protections.[^c-84a0d7fa89]

title: Security risk assessments include repository protection status
summary: The GitHub code security risk assessment and secret risk assessment now show whether findings are in protected or unprotected repositories, helping you identify where to extend your security coverage.[^c-37c97ff3b1] Organization admins and security managers can start an assessment by going to Assessments under their organization’s Security tab.[^c-d5f11a5354]

title: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
summary: When you sign in to GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 or later, eligible accounts can now use short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens.[^c-35150327ad] Short-lived access tokens reduce how long a leaked token can be used.[^c-c23fb09ae6] Desktop automatically refreshes them for GitHub API requests and Git operations, keeping token renewal out of your everyday workflow.[^c-cba933c51e]

title: Limit what agents learn about private repos with enclaves
summary: Enclaves are a new security primitive for cross-repository GitHub Agentic Workflows.[^c-202053047b] Enclaves let agents work on different repositories while limiting what they say to each other.[^c-094189d3e1]

title: Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world
summary: Louis Erbkamm built the first prototype in his free time.[^c-241eb658cd] Now GitHub Copilot helps him maintain it alone.[^c-553dd5447f] Louis Erbkamm knows his way around Arnis, the smallest town in Germany, but he’s never set foot in it.[^c-91bbac5750]

title: Dependabot now supports Python 3.15
summary: You can now upgrade your projects to Python 3.15 and keep receiving Dependabot updates.[^c-480450117c] Support for Python 3.15 is available to all github.com users and will be included in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.[^c-2a09e3cad5]

title: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 features and JSON data extensions
summary: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code.[^c-7fba6bbd0a]

title: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air
Look up a resource’s cost center with the GitHub REST API
summary: You can now use the GitHub REST API to find which cost center a user, organization, repository, or enterprise team belongs to.[^c-f0dd03cecb] Previously, you had to list every cost center and scan its resources.[^c-2450c19325] Pass the resource type and name to the new endpoint.[^c-fab4320939]

title: Dependabot version updates support Agent Package Manager
BYOK and enterprise custom models in the Copilot usage API
summary: The Copilot usage metrics API now shows bring your own key (BYOK) usage across GitHub Copilot, so you can separate it from Copilot-hosted model usage.[^c-87bab73f3d]

title: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
CodeQL 2.27.4 improves accuracy and query metadata
summary: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code.[^c-57a4de9296]

title: Browse over remote agent host connections (Preview)
Mix and match agent harnesses in one session (Preview)
summary: Nested sessions in Visual Studio Code can use a different harness than their parent session.[^c-a20c59252b] Each nested chat keeps its own model, agent, and permission levels based on its harness.[^c-2dc5840e18]

title: Cron schedules and custom agents for local automations
summary: Local automations in Visual Studio Code can use five-field cron expressions when preset schedules are not precise enough.[^c-0195db3701] They can also use custom agents from the selected workspace.[^c-beadd48961] Cron schedules are not available for cloud automations.[^c-2d3c0c6ddd]

title: Copilot harness
summary: The Copilot harness continues to be the default for new sessions in VS Code.[^c-3deae1693e]

title: Working set improvements (Experimental)
summary: Last release, we introduced the working set for Copilot harness sessions, letting you review pending agent edits.[^c-d049422579] You can keep or undo changes, as you could do with the Local harness.[^c-6fb4095dae]

title: Improved guidance when required sandboxing is unavailable
summary: Agent sandboxing limits what terminal commands can access, like the file system and network resources.[^c-e9e606abe7] Your organization can require it with managed settings that disallow bypassing the sandbox.[^c-f76955ee99] If your organization requires sandboxing but your machine can't run it, the warning banner explains why terminal commands are blocked and how to resolve the problem.[^c-acf3ad24c3]

title: Choose agent verbosity (Experimental)
summary: Keep long chats readable, or follow the agent's reasoning and tool calls in detail when you need to understand its actions.[^c-31c8f22588]

title: Chat performance improvements
summary: Reopen and browse long Copilot harness chats more smoothly.[^c-135ea878f9] VS Code reuses existing reasoning titles and renders terminal output as you reveal it.[^c-a92b38d9e3] Terminal output in restored tool calls is rendered when you expand or reveal it, rather than all at once.[^c-837cfabd16]

title: Inline chat attachments (Experimental)
summary: Keep file references and other context next to the instructions they belong to.[^c-fb32e73a37] Enable this setting to insert attachment pills at the cursor in your prompt, rather than in a separate row above the input.[^c-fec5922955] Move across, select, or delete an attachment pill as a single character.[^c-4445f69850]

title: Attach files from anywhere on your computer
Support for tools provided by MCP apps
summary: MCP apps are interactive interfaces provided by MCP servers.[^c-e13e17700b]

title: Show specific files in excluded folders
Smart subgraph titles in Mermaid diagrams
summary: Edges in Mermaid diagrams no longer cover subgraph titles.[^c-95e75ae7d8] A title moves to the side when an edge would cross it.[^c-f8bcabe574] With the default vscode Mermaid theme, subgraphs are outlined instead of filled, so nested subgraphs stand out.[^c-84afb6e84b]

title: Managed MCP allowlists take precedence over registry-only access
summary: The enterprise-managed allowedMcpServers list now takes precedence over registry-only access.[^c-8fe026024e] Matching servers can run without registry publication, while registry servers that do not match are blocked.[^c-8fe026024e] An empty list blocks all servers.[^c-58be259613] User and workspace allowlists cannot add servers to the enterprise list.[^c-6c93595d6e]
